sections.heading: About Governing Council
content: The Government of Andhra Pradesh established Rajiv Gandhi University of Knowledge Technologies (RGUKT) in 2008 to cater to the educational needs of the meritorious rural youth of Andhra Pradesh. Four Institutions (IIITs) are established under RGUKT, one each at Nuzivid (Krishna dt), Rajiv Knowledge Valley (Kadapa dt), Ongole and Srikakulam. These autonomous Institutions will specialize in teaching and research in Information Technology and other emerging engineering and other disciplines under the control of a common University Governing Council and following a common syllabus.

sections.heading: Dr. B. Prasad M.Tech (IIT Bombay), Ph.D (IIT Tirupati)
content: Dr. B. Prasad, M.Tech, is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering at Rajiv Gandhi University of Knowledge Technologies – Nuzvid, with over 15 years of teaching experience (as of 29 October 2025). His expertise includes Control of Linear and Non-Linear Systems using AI, Network Theory, Control Systems, MEMS Fabrication Methods, Analog Electronics and Measurements & Instrumentation.

sections.heading: Experience
content: Total 15 years of teaching experience as on 29th August 2025.

sections.heading: Specialization & Research Areas
content: His research focuses on AI for Distributed Fog Computing, Non-linear Control of Autonomous Systems using AI/ML Techniques, Soft Sensors, Micro and Nano Sensors. He is actively involved in MHRD-sponsored projects: “Design and Development of Agro Sensors” (₹ 58 lakhs) and “Design and Development of Bio Sensors” (₹ 55 lakhs) (both ongoing). In terms of leadership roles, he has served as OSD to Chancellor (RGUKT-AP), Dean (Academic) (I/c) – RGUKT Nuzvid, Campus Placement In-Charge – RGUKT Nuzvid, and Branch Coordinator (ECE) – RGUKT Nuzvid.

sections.heading: Dr. D.V.Nagarjana Devi M.Tech, PhD
content: Dr. D.V. Nagarjana Devi, M.Tech, Ph.D., is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at RGUKT Nuzvid, where she has been working since January 2012. She holds a Diploma in Computer Science and Engineering, a B.Tech in CSE, an M.Tech in CS, and a Ph.D. She has 19 years of teaching and administrative experience, having previously worked at GITAM University, CM Engineering College (Malla Reddy Group), and S.R.K.R Engineering College.

Her teaching areas include C and Data Structures, Data Mining, DBMS, Operating Systems, Distributed Systems, File Structures, Computer Organization, Advanced Unix Programming, and OOP with C++. She has also conducted labs on these subjects.

Dr. Devi has attended several professional development programs, including refresher courses on IoT, AI, and Machine Learning at JNTU Hyderabad and FDPs on AI, Machine Learning, and IoT. She also completed industrial training in Amazon Web Services and Data Analytics Using Tableau.

Her research interests include Sentiment Analysis, Machine Learning, Data Mining, IoT, Artificial Intelligence, and Distributed Systems. She has published research papers in leading journals, such as IJERCSE and IJERA, covering topics like emotion-based music recommendation, sarcasm detection, and web page classification. Her conference presentations include IEEE and Springer events on AI, sentiment analysis, and edge computing.

Dr. Devi has held multiple administrative roles at RGUKT, including Dean of Student Welfare (2016–2019), Finance Officer (2022–present), Training & Placement Officer (2021–2022), and Head of the Department (2014–2015). She has also served as Hostel Warden and Mess Committee Chairman and contributed to student welfare and campus administration.
